title: Review verdict (exeris-web)
description: The bundle's shape, narrowed to this repository's reviewing role and its surfaces. The three-state `decision` and the `checks_run` contract are the base's; only the vocabulary is local. `scope_class` names which of the site's surfaces a change touches, which is finer than the four classes ADR-085 §E.16 fixes for a pull-request body.

agent.description: One role, because one role emits: `exeris-web-reviewer` is the only profile naming this schema in `output`. The CI review is the organisation's, under its own role and schema, and does not validate against this file.
